# Tokens API

8 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/admin/tokens`

List all API tokens

List all API tokens across users (admin only)

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | query | integer | no | Minimum: 1. |
| `per_page` | query | integer | no | Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Paginated list of tokens | `application/json`: object |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of [AdminToken](schemas.md#admintoken) | no | - |
| `page` | integer | no | - |
| `per_page` | integer | no | - |
| `total` | integer | no | - |

### `DELETE /api/v1/admin/tokens/{tokenId}`

Revoke any API token

Revoke any user's API token (admin only)

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tokenId` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Token revoked | - |
| `404` | Token not found | - |

### `POST /api/v1/auth/tokens`

Create own API token

Create a new API token for the current user

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expires_at` | string (date-time) | no | - |
| `kind` | string | yes | One of: `access`, `deploy`. |
| `name` | string | yes | - |
| `scopes` | array of string | no | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Token created | `application/json`: [TokenCreateResponse](schemas.md#tokencreateresponse) |
